courseTitle: Intimate Care and Nappy Changing – Level 1
pageTitle: Intimate Care and Nappy Changing – Level 1 · Inspired
pageDescription: A one-hour Early Years intimate-care knowledge course with six modules, visual explainers and a separate school-supervised practical observation checklist. Review edition.
safeguarding: Early Years · Dignity in everyday care
heroLead: Confident, respectful care, one thoughtful step at a time. For Early Years teachers and teaching assistants.
pilotNotice: Internationally informed training for review. School procedures, staffing, care plans and translations must be approved before rollout. Online completion records knowledge and reflection; it does not establish practical competence. Progress stays in this browser.
showActText: Six applied reflections, six quick checks and a 20-question assessment. Five critical safety questions must all be answered correctly.
completionEvidenceText: Complete every module, achieve 80% with all critical answers correct, and acknowledge your responsibilities. Then arrange a separate supervised practical observation at school.
timing: Modules and activities: 48 minutes · Assessment: 10 minutes · Acknowledgements: 2 minutes. Timing will be checked in a staff pilot.
